title: The Agentic ETF: How Agentic Trading Becomes an Asset Class
abstract: arXiv:2610.06856v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Three structural trends are converging in public markets: the exchange-traded fund (ETF) has become the dominant fund wrapper, actively managed ETFs are the fastest-growing segment within it, and algorithmic systems now mediate the overwhelming majority of trading volume. We argue that their intersection defines a nascent asset class -- the \emph{Agentic ETF}, a fund whose investment process is delegated to autonomous, large-language-model-driven trading agents that reason over data and execute without a human in the loop. We define agentic trading and distinguish it from rule-based algorithmic trading and robo-advice, decompose the agentic-trading infrastructure into six layers, and identify the incumbent players and structural gaps at each layer. translated_title: 智能体ETF：智能体交易如何成为一种资产类别
translated_abstract: 公开市场中正有三股结构性趋势汇聚：交易所交易基金（ETF）已成为占主导地位的基金载体，主动管理型ETF是其中增长最快的细分市场，而算法系统如今承担了绝大部分交易量的中介。我们认为，这三者的交汇定义了一种新兴的资产类别——智能体ETF（Agentic ETF），即一种将投资过程委托给自主的、由大语言模型驱动的交易智能体的基金，这些智能体能够对数据进行推理并执行交易，全程无需人类参与。我们定义了智能体交易，并将其与基于规则的算法交易和智能投顾区分开来，将智能体交易基础设施分解为六个层次，并识别了每一层的现有参与者和结构性空白。随后，我们展示了ScalarField.io作为一体化智能体交易技术栈的参考实现——涵盖统一的多场所执行注册表、具备连续（隔离策略智能体）……
tldr: 本文提出“智能体ETF”这一新兴资产类别——由大语言模型驱动的自主交易智能体全权负责投资决策与执行的基金，将其与规则算法交易和智能投顾区分，并给出六层基础设施框架及参考实现ScalarField.io。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "Agentic ETF" as a nascent asset class — a fund delegating its investment process to autonomous LLM-driven trading agents — distinguishing it from rule-based algorithmic trading and robo-advice, while proposing a six-layer infrastructure framework and a reference implementation, ScalarField.io.
